intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 1  Multiply: A₁ × A₂, then add powers
2  Divide: A₁ ÷ A₂, then subtract powers
4  Add/subtract: match powers first, combine A values
commonMistakes: 20 × 10⁵ is NOT standard form → adjust to 2 × 10⁶.
Multiply → add powers; divide → subtract. Don't mix them up.
Addition/subtraction needs the SAME power before combining.
Don't drop the 10ⁿ when calculating just the A values.
intro.visualAid: Two-column summary: Multiply/Divide column — deal with A and 10ⁿ separately, then adjust. Add/Subtract column — make powers match first, then combine A, then adjust.

questions.content: Sun–Earth = 1.5 × 10⁸ km. Light speed = 3 × 10⁵ km/s. a) Time for light? b) Convert to minutes.
Sand grain mass = 6.5 × 10⁻⁵ kg. Bag has 2 × 10⁶ grains. a) Total bag mass? b) Bags for 1 tonne?
